name: PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk manufactures, markets, and distributes consumer goods in Indonesia. The company operates in two segments: Home and Personal Care; and Foods and Refreshment. It offers soaps, detergents, dairy based foods, ice creams, cosmetic products, tea-based beverages, and fruit juices.
